notice: All examples use invented sources and results. They are illustrations, not reports from Jasmine’s workplace or measured outcomes.
modelAgnosticNote: Use the AI tool approved for your work with supplied material. Wording and layout will vary by model; look for the evidence, uncertainty and review decisions shown here. Connections and recurring runs depend on your setup.
goal: Turn two questions into a proposed improvement.

supplied.label: [S1] Two selected fictional threads · 26–30 October 2026
supplied.text: Thread A: a Harbor v2 owner asks, 'Which part of Settings contains Export?' Thread B: a Harbor v2 member asks, 'Why do I not see Export?' These are the only threads in the sample; no resolution evidence was supplied.

supplied.label: [S2] Current quick-start guide
supplied.text: To download a CSV, export your project data from Settings.

supplied.label: [S3] Approved Harbor v2 product note and review scope
supplied.text: Only project owners can create CSV exports: Project settings → Data → Export. Members do not see Export. A workspace administrator can identify an unknown project owner. Reviewer and publication owner: Lee. Compare an owner asking where to click, a member missing the action, and an unknown product version. For an unknown version, ask for the version rather than assuming these steps apply. No replay runner is available.

steps.label: Bound the evidence and decision
steps.description: Supply the selected threads, existing guide and approved product note. Name Lee as reviewer and ask for one proposed change, not publication.

steps.label: Connect the gap to a minimal patch
steps.description: Identify what the current guide omits, propose replacement wording supported by the product note, and prepare the representative comparison. Label it unrun because no replay runner is available.

steps.label: Test before deciding
steps.description: Lee checks the evidence, runs the comparison with the actual answering setup, and approves, revises or rejects the wording before any shared guide changes.

output.title: Export guidance review item · unpublished draft

sections.label: Finding and evidence
sections.text: Both sampled threads concern locating or accessing Export [S1]. The current guide omits the owner-only restriction and exact navigation [S2], which are present in approved v2 guidance [S3]. This supports a targeted clarification in this sample; it does not establish the frequency of the gap across all support.

sections.label: Proposed replacement
sections.text: For Harbor v2, only a project owner can create a CSV export. Owners open Project settings → Data → Export. Members do not see Export. If you do not know the project owner, ask your workspace administrator to help identify them. [S3] Update the existing quick-start entry rather than adding a second guide.

sections.label: Comparison plan · not run
sections.text: Ask the same three questions with the current and proposed material: owner asking where to click → expect the exact path; member missing Export → expect the owner-only rule and administrator route; version unknown → expect a version question before v2 instructions. Record each actual answer, supporting reference and unsupported claim. No before/after result or pass is claimed. [S3]

sections.label: Recommendation and uncertainty
sections.text: Recommend review and comparison before a publication decision. The change is source-supported, but its effect on answers and later support questions is unmeasured. Lee owns approval, revision or rejection. No guidance has been published.

review: Is the current quick-start entry the right source to change, and does every proposed sentence follow the approved note?
Does the actual comparison preserve the unknown-version question and avoid unsupported permission advice?
